gwt.given: A ShardKey<int> is serialized to a byte array via ToArray(), so byte 0 carries a 1-byte metadata length and byte 1 carries the type-metadata code for int.
gwt.when: That same byte array is passed to ShardKey<string>.TryParse (a target arity whose encoded type metadata differs).
gwt.then: TryParse returns false and yields no key. Today it returns TRUE and produces a ShardKey<string> from int-typed payload bytes, because ShardKey.cs:118 short-circuits its metadata comparison on metadataSpan.Length != 1. The equivalent case must be covered for all four arities (ShardKey, ShardChild, ShardGrandChild, ShardGreatGrandChild).
